name: TSMC
description: TSMC is the world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry, manufacturing chips designed by other companies (Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm and hundreds of others) rather than selling any chips of its own. It makes money by selling wafers priced by process node, volume, and the value of the intellectual property/design-for-manufacturing services bundled in, so profitability depends heavily on how quickly customers migrate to its newest, most expensive nodes and on fab utilization. TSMC pioneered and still defines the pure-play foundry business model, and its scale and leading-edge process leadership (down to 2nm-class nodes) give it a dominant share of the most advanced logic manufacturing in the world.

businessLines.name: High Performance Computing (HPC) — by platform
businessLines.description: Wafers for CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators used in data centers, PCs and networking, including chips for NVIDIA, AMD, and hyperscaler custom silicon.
businessLines.revenueNote: 58% of FY2025 net revenue; company reports platform mix in percentage terms in quarterly management reports rather than absolute USD in every disclosure

businessLines.name: Smartphone — by platform
businessLines.description: Wafers for mobile application processors and related chips, historically TSMC's largest platform, led by Apple.

businessLines.name: IoT — by platform
businessLines.description: Wafers for Internet-of-Things and edge devices.

businessLines.name: Automotive — by platform
businessLines.description: Wafers for automotive microcontrollers, power management and ADAS/sensor chips.
businessLines.revenueNote: 5% of FY2025 net revenue; grew 34% year-over-year

businessLines.name: DCE and Others — by platform
businessLines.description: Digital consumer electronics and other smaller platform categories.
businessLines.revenueNote: DCE ~1%, Others ~2% of FY2025 net revenue

businessLines.name: Revenue by process node (3nm)
businessLines.description: Wafers manufactured on TSMC's most advanced commercially-shipping node during 2025.

profileAgainst: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, supplemented by TSMC's Q4 2025 investor management report (January 2026)
